headings: Breaking the Silo: Turning Fragmented Hunts Into Operational Awareness With a Common Operating Picture

metadata.name: description
metadata.content: Threat hunters frequently rely on fragmented notes and inconsistent case records, making it difficult to correlate weak signals, preserve prior analysis, and quickly determine the scope of an intrusion.
